CHECK BURST CS-assets-dress — cut, register, SCALE-GATE and catalogue the isolated trees and props; build a T3l props package for the spawn crop; rebuild the dressed crop from bare ground + shadow + assets (Matt R-C3-61/62/68/73). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-assets-dress".

Inputs (read-only): isolated sheets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-dress-T1/objiso_dress_T1.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-dress-T2/objiso_dress_T2.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-dress-P/objiso_dress_P.png (#00ff00 background); layout /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/objsheet_dress_layout.json (per sheet id T1/T2/P: tiles with id = asset name, crop_box [x0,y0,x1,y1] in crop px, sheet_xy, sheet_size, scale); BEFORE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn_canvas.png; AFTER /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-dress-spawn/dress_spawn.png; crop origin in level px /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn.json (origin_px). Frozen /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py extract(edge_mode='clamp') for the key. The T3l props.json contract is SPEC § 7 row T3l in /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md (read that row only). python glue PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — per tile: cut sheet_xy+sheet_size, clamp-matte → RGBA, resize by 1/scale (premultiplied LANCZOS) to the crop_box size. Keep only the largest alpha component group (alpha ≥ 32, 3-px grouping dilation) plus groups ≥ 150 px not touching the tile border.
STEP 2 — REGISTRATION: integer shift search ±10 px minimising mean |RGB| vs AFTER over alpha ≥ 200 pixels; report shift + residual; flag |shift| > 3 or residual > 20; apply the shift.
STEP 3 — SCALE GATE (camera projection: 100.62 px per metre across the screen, 60.62 px per vertical metre, 80.31 px per metre of ground depth): expected bbox height = vertical_m × 60.62 + ground_depth_m × 80.31, expected width = ground_width_m × 100.62, with nominal sizes: tree_living_a and tree_living_b — height 8.0 m total with a 5.5 m crown (expected bbox: height = (8.0 − 2.75) × 60.62 + 2.75 × 100.62, width = 5.5 × 100.62); snag_scorched — vertical 4.5 m, depth 0.8 m, width 1.6 m (branches); stump_a/stump_b — vertical 0.6 m, depth 0.8 m, width 0.8 m; cache_crates_barrel — vertical 1.2 m, depth 1.0 m, width 1.5 m; rock_a/b/c — vertical 0.5 m, depth 0.8 m, width 0.9 m. Measure each asset's opaque bbox (alpha ≥ 128); report ratio measured/expected for height and width; PASS within ±25 % on both, else FAIL (measured facts only).
STEP 4 — SHADOW (one sprite for the whole crop): R = luminance(AFTER)/luminance(BEFORE), both 11-px Gaussian blurred; s = clip(1 − R, 0, 0.7); s = 0 where s < 0.05; NO exclusion under assets (assets are composited over it); soften 2 px. Save out/props/shadow_spawn.png as black RGB with alpha = s (1536×1024).
STEP 5 — PROPS PACKAGE (T3l schema exactly): out/props/assets/<name>.png (tight RGBA, 2-px pad); out/props/props.json with assets [{name, file 'assets/<name>.png', anchor = [bottom-centre x of the lowest opaque rows (bottom 6 rows' x-centroid), lowest opaque row y + 1] in asset px, footprint {w, h} in level px (trees 80×64, snag 60×48, stumps 70×56, cache 150×90, rocks 80×64), collide true for all, fade_when_behind true for the two trees and the snag, false otherwise}], instances [{asset, position = crop origin + (asset anchor mapped to crop px)}], shadows [{file 'shadow_spawn.png', position = crop origin, opacity 1.0}], overhead [], near [], particles []. Validate it with export.props_layer's own loader/validator (import it read-only from the burst repo; report its verdict).
STEP 6 — REBUILD: BEFORE × (1 − s) then assets over, sorted by anchor y → out/rebuild.png; out/rebuild_vs_after.png (rebuild | AFTER | |diff|×3 at 768×512 each); out/asset_sheet.png (every asset over mid-grey at 1× with its name, measured bbox and scale-gate ratios); out/catalogue.json (per asset: name, kind, size_px, anchor, level_position, footprint, scale gate numbers, light 'upper-left', register 'H1', provenance {dress edit, isolate burst, sheet, tile}); out/summary.txt ≤ 15 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-assets-dress"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL for the burst.
